newsitem.title: USA: LA City Council approves water board appointment.
newsitem.headline: LA City Council approves water board appointment.

text.p: The Los Angeles City Council has confirmed the nomination of Rick Caruso as a member of the city Board of Water and Power Commissioners, city officials said on Thursday.
An attorney and real estate broker, Caruso currently is president of Caruso Affiliated Holdings, a real estate investment and development company.
The Board oversees the city Department of Water and Power.
